name: Swedcoin
description: Swedcoin (SWED) is a TRC20 token on Tron, deployed on 12 May 2021. Ownership was renounced on 9 June 2026 and 122,000,007 tokens were burned, leaving a fixed supply of 77,999,993. The project is building a platform for trust deeds recorded on a public ledger; the platform is in development.
